description:
Relax Your Mind | Santoor & Tanpura | 1.5 Hours of Evening Calm

At the end of a full day, the mind is still busy even when the body wants to rest.

This peaceful Indian ambient meditation music is designed to loosen mental tension, soften the noise of the day, and ease you into a calm, unhurried evening.

Enjoy 1 hour 30 minutes of warm santoor melodies blended with gentle tanpura drone, soft ambient textures, and shimmering resonant phrases that gradually settle the mind.

Perfect for evening relaxation, unwinding after work, stress relief, reading, dinner ambience, meditation, mindfulness, journaling, and peaceful nights at home.

🎵 ABOUT THIS MUSIC
Instrument: Santoor (hammered strings) & Tanpura Drone
Raga: Raga Khamaj — warm, earthy evening character
Style: Indian ambient meditation / calm evening instrumental
Mood: Warm, gentle, settling, spacious
Atmosphere: Evening calm, relaxation, quiet mind
Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes

🎧 HOW TO USE
Play this in the evening — while winding down after work, over dinner, reading, or before your night routine. Keep the volume soft and let the shimmering santoor slow the mind down. For the most immersive experience, use headphones or listen in a quiet room.
